text:
deploy-bot: preflight check failed — prompt-eval gate blocked promotion for rc/2026.03.20. Reason: summarizer_v2 vs baseline shows regression beyond threshold. Auto-block engaged.

eval-gate-bot: quick summary — QA suite 'prompt-qa-summarizer' delta: accuracy -3.4%, precision -2.1%, hallucination +1.6%. Fail threshold = -2.0% accuracy. Full report: https://internal/reports/3532107890

pm-lina: ack. what's the scope? is it across all traffic or just a narrow sample?

alice: looks concentrated on long-form customer summaries (>700 tokens) and on a subset of legal prompts. small sample size for legal but signal is consistent in sampling.

ben: repro snippet:```
# eval run
eval-run --suite prompt-qa-summarizer --model summarizer_v2 --baseline summarizer_v1 --seed 42
# result: QA acc -3.4%, avg rouge -0.9
```

carol: if we pin to v1 we keep quality but lose the new latency improvements. v2 adds ~8% token throughput for short calls which matters for search workloads.

pm-lina: options? rollback full release, partial pin for specific routes, or hotfix tweak to v2 to address legal prompt tokenization? need recommendation and impact to SLAs.

ben: recommendation: staged fallback — route legal-long and summarizer-legal routes to v1, others to v2. Create a hotfix branch to adjust contraction rules and rerun evals. This avoids full rollback and keeps perf for most traffic.

sre-josh: need to confirm capacity for dual-model routing. If we pin routes to v1 we must ensure GPU pool burst headroom during peak. I'll run a quick capacity check.

deploy-bot: action items created: TICKET-9876 (partial-route-pin + hotfix branch), TICKET-9877 (rollout-runbook update). Suggested change window: 2026-03-20 22:00-23:00 UTC for hotfix canary.

carol: +1 for staged fallback, but require metrics gating on latency (no >5% tail increase) and error budget check.

ben: hotfix plan (short): 1) branch v2-hotfix adjust tokenization table for legal prompts 2) run targeted eval suite 3) canary deploy to 2% traffic for 1h 4) promote if QA delta < -0.5% and latency within bounds.

pm-lina: sounds reasonable. please list owners and expected ETA.

alice: owners: ben (ml) for hotfix, carol (frontend/perf) for route config, josh (sre) for capacity + canary guardrails, me (releases) for orchestration and release notes. ETA: hotfix PR today EOD, canary tonight in window.

sre-josh: capacity check done — we have ~12% spare gpu headroom in eu-west during window. can support dual routing at planned 2% canary.

eval-gate-bot: note: once hotfix PR lands we will auto-run eval-suite. request explicit approval to run canary if pass criteria met.

pm-lina: approve running the canary contingent on eval pass. pm signoff: @pm-lina :thumbsup:

ben: will open PR now and link in ticket.

alice: I'll update release notes & changelog to mention staged fallback + customer impact and mitigation. draft in TICKET-9877.

deploy-bot: scheduling: canary hold set for 2026-03-20T22:00:00Z -> manual promote window 22:00-23:00 UTC. Canary will autoscale to 2% then hold for 1h. Manual override allowed only with two engineer signoffs.

carol: please add latency dashboards and alert if p95 increases >5% relative to baseline.

ben: added dashboard panels and alert rule.

pm-lina: final ask — update customer-facing release notes after promote. keep customers informed if any follow-ups.

sre-josh: +1. I will be on-call during the window.

alice: +1.

deploy-bot: thread closed for now; will post updates when PR is merged or canary status changes.
